label: Bible Study
prompt: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and _____ are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
verse: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
note: The song of Moses and the Lamb — sung beside a sea of glass mingled with fire.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the _____ of God.
verse: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
note: Faith is the access pass: we stand in grace today and rejoice in hope of glory tomorrow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Children, obey your _____ in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verse: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
note: The children's memory verse comes with a bonus line: obeying your parents is 'well pleasing unto the Lord.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the thing which I greatly _____ is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verse: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
note: Job's worst nightmare came true — and he says so honestly instead of pretending.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The righteous shall _____ like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verse: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
note: The righteous 'flourish like the palm tree' — and two verses later they're still bearing fruit in old age.
